title: The Counting-House on Mallow Quay
objective: Get past Snikk's goblins into the burned counting-house on Mallow Quay, open the guild's strongroom, and leave by the quay steps.

rooms.name: Quay Steps
rooms.description: Slimy stone steps climb out of the river to a burned archway. A mooring bollard leans at the top, scrawled with chalk.

features.name: Mooring Bollard
features.description: An iron bollard scrawled with boatmen's chalk marks.
features.discovery: The chalk reads: "Goblin toll at the arch. Mind the gallery stair." A stoppered vial of red liquid is wedged in a crack at its foot.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Toll Arch
rooms.description: The counting-house gate, its doors burned away. A chain hung with stolen coins and bells is strung across the arch.

features.name: Toll Chain
features.description: A rusty chain hung with bent coins, buttons and bells.
features.discovery: Every coin on it has been bitten and bent. Nothing here is worth taking.

rooms.name: Counting Hall
rooms.description: A long hall of scorched ledger presses and toppled counting tables, thick with soot. A gallery stair climbs one wall, and an iron door stands in the far end.

features.name: Smashed Till
features.description: A clerk's till, its drawer prised open and dropped behind a table.
features.discovery: Silver the goblins missed is still caught in the drawer's slots.

items.name: Till Silver
items.description: A double handful of guild silver.

items.name: Soot Goblin's Coins
items.description: A greasy pouch of copper pieces.

rooms.name: Clerks' Gallery
rooms.description: A narrow gallery of clerks' desks above the hall, half its rail burned away. A ladder climbs to the loft.

features.name: Tally-Master's Desk
features.description: A heavy desk carved with the guild's scales, its drawers already turned out.

failure.text: Empty drawers and scorched tally sticks. Whatever the tally-master kept here is gone.

success.text: One drawer is shallower than the rest. Behind its false back lies a bloodstone.

items.name: Bloodstone
items.description: A dark green stone flecked with red.

rooms.name: Records Loft
rooms.description: Charred bales of records under the roof beams, and a nest of torn ledgers that smells of something large.

items.name: Iron Key
items.description: A heavy iron key stamped with the guild's scales.

items.name: The Clerk-Eater's Coins
items.description: A small pouch of silver pieces.

items.name: The Clerk-Eater's Silver Trinket
items.description: A small silver ornament, dented but valuable.

rooms.name: Strongroom
rooms.description: An iron-lined vault the fire never reached. An iron coffer is bolted to the floor.

features.name: Iron Coffer
features.description: An iron coffer bolted to the floor, its lid unlocked.
features.discovery: Inside lie two garnets in a twist of velvet, a gold chain of office and a sealed bag of guild gold.

items.name: Second Garnet
items.description: A deep red garnet, a twin to the first.

items.name: Chain of Office
items.description: A gold chain hung with the guild's scales.

items.name: Bag of Guild Gold
items.description: A sealed canvas bag of gold pieces.

passages.description: The steps up to the arch.
The scorched doorway into the hall.

trap.name: Scything Blade
trap.description: A spring-loaded blade under a loose tread of the gallery stair.
trap.trigger: A tread sinks under your foot and a blade scythes out of the stair.

door.name: Strongroom Door
door.description: A squat iron door with a lock the size of a fist.

opponents.name: Snikk the Toll-Taker
opponents.description: A goblin in a burned clerk's coat steps out under the chain, scimitar on his shoulder and a ledger under his arm.

failure-by-5.text: Snikk snaps his ledger shut and swings before you finish.

failure.text: Snikk licks his pencil and writes something unkind about you.

success.text: Snikk scratches his chin with the pencil.

success-by-5.text: Snikk ticks a line in his ledger and lifts the chain for you.

toll.text: Snikk bites each coin, writes you into his ledger and lifts the chain.

unfriendly.text: "Five gold to pass the arch, or you go back in the river."

uncertain.text: Snikk looks you up and down and taps the ledger: "Toll's five gold."

friendly.text: Snikk grins and waves you under the chain: "Got knives, if you need knives."

opponents.name: Soot Goblin
opponents.description: A soot-blackened goblin uncurls from behind a ledger press, scimitar first.

opponents.name: The Clerk-Eater
opponents.description: The nest of ledgers heaves, and a bugbear with an iron key on a thong at its neck rises out of it, hammer in hand.

endings.title: Out with the guild's gold
endings.text: You go down the quay steps with the counting-house's silver in your pack, and nobody asks you for a toll.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You go down the quay steps with nothing but soot to show for the counting-house.

endings.title: Fallen on Mallow Quay
endings.text: You fall among the burned ledgers. Your adventuring ends here.
